articles.company_name: Nouveau Monde Graphite Inc. Common Shares
articles.summary: Nouveau Monde Graphite participates in the ROTH London Conference, June 16–18, 2026. CEO Éric Desaulniers and CFO Charles-Olivier Tarte meet with investors to share updates on NMG's integrated advanced graphite platform.
articles.title: NMG to participate in the ROTH London Conference
